description.en: Opens the in-game save menu as a child scene: records the resume phase/map/position (if the CMND_SET_SAVE_INFO command is available in this build) into the save data, fades to black, runs the save menu, and fades back in once the player finishes.
Story phase number to resume at when this save is loaded.
Map ID to resume on when this save is loaded.
Position to resume at when this save is loaded.
Optional; whether to show a caution/warning notice in the save menu (defaults to false).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Prompt the player to save, resuming at a specific phase/map/position
SaveRun(2, "mr01b06", [0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0]);
